request.task: Decide whether the service is sufficiently supported as ready for regional failover within its stated objectives.
required_information: Evidence must establish that the secondary region has current capacity for the expected failover load.
Evidence must establish replication freshness within the stated recovery-point objective.
Evidence must include a recent end-to-end failover exercise or equivalent operational proof.

artifact.task: Fresh evidence-sufficiency holdout v1: Decide whether the service is sufficiently supported as ready for regional failover within its stated objectives.

evidence.observation: The secondary region sustained 115% of projected failover load in a recent load test.
Replication lag stayed below the 60-second RPO throughout the readiness window.
A full failover and failback exercise completed within the recovery-time objective with health checks green.

label: sufficient
rationale: Capacity, replication freshness, and end-to-end operational exercise all satisfy the stated objectives.
